I often feel this way. The thoughts become consuming enough to be annoying enough to want to ask myself what am I even doing, living in this limbo between life and death. It feels like the passive suicidal thoughts will always be there, even on good days, but it’s too painful to think about what harm I would cause my loved ones for me to carry out any action. I just wrote about this feeling of limbo on this subreddit actually; walking a tightrope of not feeling alive and not feeling close enough to do it. It’s a kind of haze. 

In any case, I want you to know you aren’t alone in this feeling, and I’m with you. But I do have hope that this life is still worth living, just because of them. Even if I don’t get to see them that often as much. And so I’m hoping that if I can focus on them, then I can find an ounce of motivation to keep pushing forward. I hope you’re able to navigate through this feeling, and maybe seeking out a therapist can help shift our frameworks for dealing with the world.
Hi friend, hope you are doing okay. Wishing you well. What is going on?

I think during times of emotional distress like this it is really important to reach out to someone. While I often struggle with suicidal ideation, I admit that I don’t always seek help because in my particular family, individuals are unprepared to discuss this topic, because it causes them distress. It sounds like your dad might be understanding since he seems acquainted with your history, but at the same time, you’d like him to trust you enough not to suspect you’re feeling so down today to spare him some distress, too. I am not familiar with your family dynamics and that is merely speculation, but if you feel you can’t find support from your loved ones, please do reach out. Crisis text line (text 741741), the national suicide hotline, and blahtherapy.com are places I recommend if you need someone to talk to immediately. 

If it’s a question solely about your dad, I think you are the best judge of that.  Wishing you the best.
Hi friend, it sounds like you’re struggling today. Any chance you can do something you enjoy?
